shortIntro.title: What Your Device Needs for Smooth MadOut2 Gameplay 🚗💥📱
shortIntro.para1: MadOut2 BigCityOnline is not your average mobile game — it’s a full open-world chaos simulator. Massive maps, fast cars, explosions, NPC traffic, and online players all at once mean your device must work HARD.
shortIntro.para2: From drifting cars at full speed to causing city-wide mayhem, MadOut2 pushes your CPU, GPU, and RAM to their limits. Weak phones don’t crash cars — they crash themselves 😅🔥.

intro: Below are the minimum and recommended specifications to enjoy MadOut2 without lag, stutters, or rage-quitting. Tested by street racers, chaos lovers, and accidental pedestrians 😎🚓.

minimum.Internet: Required for online mode – unstable net = teleporting cars 💀

recommended.Storage: 6GB+ free space (maps + cars + updates add up fast)
recommended.Internet: Stable Wi-Fi or 4G/5G for online city chaos

ios_intro: MadOut2 runs surprisingly smooth on iOS 🍏 thanks to Apple’s strong GPUs and memory optimization. Less lag, smoother driving, fewer random freezes.

ios_recommended.title: Device

ios_recommended.title: Storage
ios_recommended.value: 6GB+ free space for smooth city loading

fps_intro: FPS is everything in MadOut2! Low FPS = delayed steering, broken drifts, and missed turns 🚗💨.
settings_intro: Proper graphics settings turn MadOut2 from laggy mess into smooth madness 🛠️🔥.

low_end.title: Graphics Quality

high_end.title: Frame Rate

faqIntroText: MadOut2 FAQs — because city chaos raises questions 😎🚓:

faqList.question: Is MadOut2 a heavy game?
faqList.answer: Yes. The huge map, vehicles, traffic, and online players make it one of the heaviest mobile games.

faqList.question: Why does MadOut2 lag on my phone?
faqList.answer: Low RAM, weak GPU, or high graphics settings can cause lag. Reduce traffic and shadows for instant improvement.

faqList.question: Does MadOut2 heat phones?
faqList.answer: Yes, especially during online mode and long driving sessions. Take breaks or lower graphics 😅.
